veil_note: Mano Amica Foundation · Italy — standing by those who need it most.
home_h1: An outstretched hand changes an entire life.
home_sub: We support the most vulnerable people with food, care and dignity. Every donation, big or small, becomes a concrete gesture.
home_mission_h2: Close to those whom life has tested.
home_m1_p: A safe place for those who don't have one: hot meals, listening, first assistance.
home_m2_p: Access to basic medical care for families and people in difficulty.
home_m3_p: Training and reintegration pathways, so every story can start again.
cs_h1: A family that chose to open its doors.
cs_lead: Mano Amica was born from a simple story: that of a family who decided to turn their closeness into concrete help for those who need it most.
cs_story_p1: It all started with a daily gesture, that of reaching out to those around us. Over time, that gesture grew into a foundation: a space where every vulnerable person can find welcome, care and a listening ear, without ever feeling judged.
cs_story_p2: Today we work every day to make that help even more concrete and accessible, in Italy and beyond, with the same simplicity with which it all began: one hand reaching out to another.
cs_t1_p: He conceived and built the foundation, from the project to the site you're visiting.
cs_t2_p: Accompanies the foundation with his presence and spiritual guidance.
cs_t3_p: By the foundation's side in every initiative, with dedication and care.
ca_h1: Three concrete ways to make a difference.
ca_lead: Every project is born from a real need, encountered on the ground. Here's where your support goes.
ca_p1_p: Weekly distribution of food, clothing and hygiene products to the most vulnerable families.
ca_p2_p: Basic medical visits and guidance towards local healthcare facilities.
ca_p3_p: Courses and support pathways towards employment and lasting independence.
ca_p4_p: A free listening space for those going through a difficult time.
ca_trans_p: Every euro raised goes directly to active projects on the ground. We regularly publish a report on the actions carried out, so that donors can see the concrete impact of their gesture.

modal_sepa_note: Make the transfer from your online banking with these details (also works from another country, thanks to the BIC/SWIFT code), then confirm below.
modal_card_redirect_note: You will be redirected to Stripe's secure payment page, where you can choose between card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and other methods available based on your country. No payment data passes through our site.
modal_paypal_pending_note: The real PayPal connection isn't active on this site yet — it will be set up separately, using your PayPal developer credentials.
modal_satispay_pending_note: The real Satispay connection isn't active on this site yet — it requires the official Satispay SDK (cryptographic request signing). It will be set up separately via the Satispay Business app.
